actionAdapters.entry: existing Unity Editor.log, Player.log, Console, redacted time-bounded Xcode or device-log export, and resolved target package Nova/{Doc,Docs,DOCS}/INDEX.md
actionAdapters.when: 关联已冻结症状的现有日志与包内文档，只读取、不新建导出文件、不修改项目

deny: all project source, configuration, Scene, Prefab, Build Settings, generated output and package contents
Unity launch, shutdown, compile, Play Mode or asset database changes
device application install, uninstall, launch, stop, clear-data, package mutation, sandbox access, certificate installation, settings change, adb forwarding or reverse forwarding
adb logcat clear, unbounded log capture, new raw-log export or local diagnostic artifact creation
vendor dashboard, external service, credential use, Git commit or push

requiredFor: accessing a connected Android or iOS device, device-specific log source or external Xcode / Console export
a device serial or UDID, Bundle ID, time window, log source or redaction-rule change
starting any bounded iOS log stream
any operation that would install, clear data, launch an application, modify a device, write a project file, create an artifact, use credentials, delete, commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认只允许读取已冻结单设备、Bundle ID、时间窗和日志源，并在输出前按冻结规则脱敏；它不授权启动应用、改变设备状态、写入本地文件或修复工程。任一目标、时间窗、来源或脱敏规则变化后重新确认。

evidence: 已脱敏的冻结平台、设备身份、Bundle ID、时间窗、日志来源与复现上下文
只读设备/包事实和时间窗内最早直接的已脱敏日志位置、异常或平台错误码
仅在命中时读取的目标 SDK/Kit 已解析包与 Nova/Doc、Nova/Docs 或 Nova/DOCS INDEX 语义
客户端事实、根因假设、未验证项与不声称厂商后台或真实设备功能成功的边界说明
